returns.title: Returns and exchanges
returns.exchange_p: Uncut, unwashed and unstitched fabric in its original packaging can be exchanged or returned within {days} days of delivery.
returns.notReturnable_p: Fabric that has been cut, stitched or washed, and sale items marked final sale.
returns.faulty_p: We replace it or refund in full, including delivery. Message us on WhatsApp with your order number and a photo.
returns.refunds_p: Cash-on-delivery refunds are paid by bank transfer within {refundDays} working days after we receive the item.

delivery.title: Delivery and fees
delivery.where_p: Riyadh city and outskirts. For other cities, ask us on WhatsApp.
delivery.feesAtCheckout: The delivery fee for your area is shown before you send your order.
delivery.timing_p: Usually 1–3 working days after we confirm your order on WhatsApp.
delivery.payment_p: Cash on delivery only. Please have the exact amount ready. We never ask for card details.

privacy.title: Privacy policy (PDPL)
privacy.collect_p: Your name, phone number, delivery area and address, and your order or request details. Measurements you save for stitching stay on your device; we only see them if you send them to us.
privacy.tryon_p: Your try-on photo never leaves your device. We do not upload or keep it.
privacy.use_p: To confirm and deliver your order, arrange stitching if you ask, and answer your requests. We send offers only if you join our WhatsApp circle. We never sell your data.
privacy.storage_p: Orders and requests are stored securely with our website and database providers, and only Thaanora staff can see them. We keep order records for as long as tax and accounting law requires.
privacy.rights_p: Under Saudi Arabia’s Personal Data Protection Law (PDPL) you can ask to see, correct or delete your data. Message us on WhatsApp.

terms.title: Terms of sale
terms.authentic_p: Every suit is an original from the named brand, bought in Pakistan, with the brand code shown.
terms.prices_p: In Saudi riyals, including {vat}% VAT. Delivery, the gift box and stitching are extra and shown before you confirm.
terms.orders_p: An order is final once we confirm it with you on WhatsApp. A discount code applies after any bundle discount; one code per order.
terms.colour_p: Screens show colours slightly differently from fabric in daylight.
terms.prices_noVat_p: In Saudi riyals. No VAT is added, because we are not VAT-registered. Delivery, the gift box and stitching are extra and shown before you confirm.

Policies.who_p: Thaanora is a brand of {company}, a one-person limited liability company registered in Saudi Arabia (Unified National No. {nationalNo}).
